event.title: Tasklet announced $20M funding round
event.summary: Tasklet has raised $20M to build the cloud agent OS for work.

sourcePreview.title: We've raised $20M to build the cloud agent OS for work

We just raised $20M from @usv, @lightspeedvp, @ycombinator, @JeffDean, @patrickc, and others to build the cloud agent OS for work. ...and I’m officially back in @ycombinator — spring ‘26 batch. It’s time to seize the moment. We're hiring!…

We just raised $20M to build the cloud agent operating system for work. The investment is led by @usv & @lightspeedvp and includes @ycombinator, @JeffDean, @patrickc & others. It values the company at $175M. 🧵
